subject: [PATCH v5 17/19] selftests/mm: race the collapse of windows with holes

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest to the Linux kernel that tests the collapse of huge pages with holes under racing conditions. The test harness simulates two scenarios: one where all PTEs are present and another where there are holes in the window. It runs both scenarios for each driver mode, including stepped and madvise modes. The test checks for corruption and reports the results.
